verdict.rationale: Warp's docs say users can describe a task in natural language and the built-in agent writes code, runs commands, and iterates until done (warp-docs-6, warp-docs-44). Multi-turn conversations support follow-ups and queued prompts (warp-docs-13, warp-docs-15, warp-docs-58), the agent can drive interactive terminal apps (warp-docs-16), and the `warp` CLI brings the same agent to any terminal (warp-docs-41). Users independently praise the AI-generated commands (warp-comm-8, warp-comm-3), though one Pro user reports random agent failures and stops (warp-comm-11). Missing for 10: the '#' natural-language command generation is now labeled Legacy (warp-docs-54), and there are hands-on reports of agent reliability problems.
